column1: # What each stage runs, read by scripts/stage.sh, whose header gives the columns
# and the rules: stage, check, quarters, hold, folder, when, command, separated
# by tabs. A row's folder is the build folder its command compiles into or
# reads that another row may use too (dev-stack-test reads dev's); a row that
# builds only where no other row of its stage does names none (-). In save
# and handoff the rows of one folder run in order on one ticket and the rest
# side by side; every other stage runs its rows in order.
# No row takes more than one quarter, since no check here takes the whole
# machine: the harness self-tests that would, go test -race and the full
# suites run on the pull request's run on GitHub. A row takes no quarter (-) when it names no folder, runs none of
# docker, mix, elixir, cargo, go, node or npm, and took under 15 s when it was
# classed. A handoff row is named when no path rule selects it: it runs on
# every pull request whose paths select its job, and here only to
# reproduce a red of that run
# (scripts/stage.sh --reproduce). The PostgreSQL rows, Dialyzer and Locus
# alone are named: what they catch the pull request's run catches too, and
# no path rule picks it out beforehand.
# tests/stage-test.sh holds that, and that every self-test a handoff row runs is
# one a pull-request workflow runs too.
# The project's own Credo check on planted sources. config/runtime.exs reads
# the umbrella's own modules, so the row runs after the dev compile, and
# compiles the umbrella itself when that compile was skipped.

column7: env MIX_BUILD_PATH=_build/dev_pg CYFR_DATABASE=postgres MIX_ENV=dev mix compile --warnings-as-errors

column1: # The rosters, config-seam and vocabulary rows run the cheap gates of the
# pull request's run that read the whole tree, so a change elsewhere turns
# them red: the roster tests (the restore order, the cross-language drift,
# the umbrella's boundaries, the test-seam source check, Sanctum's gate
# rosters, the seed catalysts' source roster, the router's route map,
# the console's context-guard roster of callbacks and tasks and the export
# declarations of Arca, Sanctum and each domain),
# CI's configuration check and its vocabulary job's script. Handoff still
# leaves to the pull request's run PostgreSQL, Dialyzer, each app compiled
# and tested alone (the island jobs), the proofs under tests/ and the
# suites' files no row names and no change touched.

column7: scripts/test-partitioned.sh -n 1 -a sqlite -- --warnings-as-errors apps/cyfr/test/cyfr/restore_order_test.exs apps/cyfr/test/cyfr/cross_language_drift_test.exs apps/cyfr/test/cyfr/boundaries_test.exs apps/cyfr/test/cyfr/test_seams_test.exs apps/cyfr/test/sanctum/gate apps/cyfr/test/integration/runtime/seed_model_catalysts_test.exs apps/cyfr/test/cyfr_web/router_test.exs apps/cyfr/test/cyfr_web/context_guard_roster_test.exs apps/cyfr/test/cyfr/boundary_declarations_test.exs
(cd apps/cyfr/assets && npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund && npx eslint . && test/run.sh) && scripts/check-seed-canvas.sh

column1: # The CYFR app's unit tests: its main process, the account pages' code it
# bundles, the fixtures both sides read and the real-CYFR proofs' entries,
# whose bundles the package guard must refuse.

column7: cd apps/codex/desktop && npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund && npm test
cd apps/codex && test -z "$(gofmt -l .)" && go vet ./... && go build ./...

column1: # The Go rows run each module's tests without -race (the pull request's
# Codex CI and Keeper CI add it) when a path its workflow's pull_request
# paths name changes; tests/stage-test.sh holds the two lists equal.
# The Rust rows take rustup's bin directory on PATH, where rustup and
# `cargo install` put their tools, and read not run 69 on a host without the
# toolchain CONTRIBUTING.md names. The test WASM fixtures' Rust recipes compile the umbrella under
# MIX_ENV=test (build-fixture.sh), so that row runs in the test folder; it
# runs for every .wasm, seed/'s too, which the check passes over.

column7: scripts/wasm-tools.sh install _tools && env PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" CYFR_DATABASE=sqlite RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN="$(sed -n 's/^rustc_version=//p' apps/cyfr/test/support/test_wasm/build-fixture.sh)" scripts/check-test-wasm.sh
